column3: Then you're not the\nthieves. Good. Stay that\nway.{end_wait}
Hmm...{pause_20_skippable} Something's off...{pause_20_skippable}\nYou{pause_20_skippable} are thieves...{end_wait}
Hahh... Nobody travels\nthrough a burned town.\nWe'll be ruined.{end_wait}

The guests upstairs
weren't in their room
when the mountain blew.{page_break}We searched it after,
and found nothing. That
alone troubles me.{end_wait}

Everyone says our guests
are the thieves.{page_break}But accusing people
without proof is how a
town tears itself apart.{page_break}They look rough, I
admit, but they've been
polite. And paid cash.{end_wait}

Those three have fooled
the innkeeper and his
wife completely.{page_break}I know their type.
They take what they
want and smile.{end_wait}

That boy, {actor_name:3}...
Something's wrong with
him.{page_break}He grabbed my arm and
just stared at me.{page_break}I shook him off. It felt
like he was reading me
like a book.{end_wait}

We haven't done anything.
You're a terrible person
if you{page_break}accuse people with no
proof at all.{end_wait}
It would be awful if our\nguests turned out to be\nthe thieves.{end_wait}

The volcano cost us half
our business, and now
this robbery!{page_break}Those three pay well.
Very well.{page_break}I'll stand up for them
if there's trouble. We
need the coin.{end_wait}

The master and his wife
are blinded by coin.{page_break}If they don't help hunt
the thieves, they'll pay
for it.{end_wait}
What do you want, kid?{end_wait}
That strange boy is with\nthem!{end_wait}
Don't let him near me!\nHe looks inside people!{end_wait}
They're very edgy.\nSomething isn't right.{end_wait}
You can't read them if\nthey keep running, can\nyou?{end_now}
Is there any way to\ncorner them?{end_wait}
There has to be a way\nto get close enough, but\nhow?{end_wait}
Maybe the three of us\ncan box one of them in.{end_wait}
Don't worry. This will\nwork. It has to.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}, you take the\nlead. I'll follow.{end_wait}
They're back!{end_wait}
Damn! They're coming at\nus one at a time!{end_wait}
Keep your distance, like\nbefore! Don't let them\nlay a hand on you!{end_wait}
There's nowhere left to\nrun!{end_wait}
Damn! I'm surrounded!{end_wait}
Now, {actor_name:3}! Do it!{end_wait}
A-All right...!{end_wait}
Wh-what is this? What's\nhe doing to me?!{end_wait}
His eyes are shut...\nWhat is he doing?{end_wait}
Are you done, {actor_name:3}?\nBe quick.{end_wait}
You freaks... Stay away\nfrom me! All of you!{end_wait}
Get out! Get out of\nmy sight!{end_wait}
Ah! Stop it!{end_wait}
No! Get out of my head!{end_wait}
What did you find,\n{actor_name:3}?{end_wait}
It's them. They took far\nmore than the rod... a\nlot of other things too.{end_wait}
They've hidden it all\nsomewhere in this inn...{end_wait}
But they'll never let me\nnear them again.{end_wait}
Then we have no choice.\nWe have to search the\ninn ourselves...{end_now}
It's a lot of ground, but\nwe're the only ones who\ncan do it. Right?{end_now}
Please, {actor_name:1}...\nI'm begging you...{end_now}
So it can't be done...?{end_wait}
We don't have time for\nthat, {actor_name:1}!{end_wait}
Leave it to us.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1} always comes\nthrough.{end_wait}
I trust your sense of\nduty.{end_wait}
It's settled. Let's go,\n{actor_name:3}.{end_wait}
Uhnn... Uhnn...{end_wait}
Ahh! Help me... please...{end_wait}
{protagonist_name} cut the ropes.\nThey had bitten into his\nwrists.{end_wait}
I came into the loft to\nfix the roof...{end_wait}
But I couldn't get to\nthe back of the loft...{page_break}So I went to look\nwhen{pause_20_skippable} WHAM!{end_wait}
Someone hit me from\nbehind!{page_break}When I woke, I was tied\nup. And bleeding.{end_wait}
These crates weren't\nhere before.\nSomething is wrong.{end_wait}
All the stolen goods are\nprobably in these crates.{end_wait}
So. We've been found out.{end_wait}
You're persistent for one\nof Hammet's pups.\nThat'll get you killed.{end_wait}
What? Even if we return\neverything and beg\nforgiveness,{page_break}it's still a crime?{end_wait}
They're only children.\nNothing to worry about.{end_wait}
